plugin.name: Automatic_Backup
plugin.author: Fiendish
plugin.purpose: Backs up the world file to a new name each day
plugin.description: Saves a backup of your world file.

muclient.script:
require "aard_lua_ffi"
function do_backup () local world_file_path = GetInfo(54) local max_backups = 30 -- Maximum number of backups to keep
if saving or (not world_file_path) or (world_file_path == "") then return end
saving = true
-- Get the world file name without the path local world_file_name = string.match(world_file_path, "([^/\\]+)$")
-- Create backup directory if it doesn't exist local backup_dir = GetInfo(67) .. "world_backups\\" .. world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "\\") aard_lua_ffi.CreateDirectory(backup_dir, true)
local world_file_with_date = backup_dir .. world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "") .. os.date (".mcl.backup-%Y-%m-%d") if Save(world_file_with_date, true) == true then saving = false return end
-- Get a list of existing backup files local backup_files = aard_lua_ffi.ListFiles(backup_dir, world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "%.mcl%.backup-.*"))
-- Remove oldest backups if there are more than max_backups if backup_files then -- Sort descending so oldest files are at the end table.sort(backup_files, function(a, b) return a > b end) while #backup_files > max_backups do os.remove(backup_dir .. backup_files[#backup_files]) table.remove(backup_files) end end
saving = false end
function migrate_old_backups () -- Migrate old backup files from format .mcl.backup-DD-MMM-YYYY to .mcl.backup-YYYY-MM-DD local world_file_path = GetInfo(54) if (not world_file_path) or (world_file_path == "") then return end
local world_file_name = string.match(world_file_path, "([^/\\]+)$") local backup_dir = GetInfo(67) .. "world_backups\\" .. world_file_name:gsub("%.[Mm][Cc][Ll]$", "\\")
local month_to_num = { Jan = "01", Feb = "02", Mar = "03", Apr = "04", May = "05", Jun = "06", Jul = "07", Aug = "08", Sep = "09", Oct = "10", Nov = "11", Dec = "12" } local old_format_files = aard_lua_ffi.ListFiles(backup_dir, "%.mcl%.backup%-%d%d%-%a%a%a%-%d%d%d%d$") if not old_format_files then return end for _, old_name in ipairs(old_format_files) do local day, mon, year = old_name:match("%.mcl%.backup%-(%d%d)%-(%a%a%a)%-(%d%d%d%d)$") if day and mon and year and month_to_num[mon] then local new_name = old_name:gsub("%.mcl%.backup%-%d%d%-%a%a%a%-%d%d%d%d$", ".mcl.backup-" .. year .. "-" .. month_to_num[mon] .. "-" .. day) os.rename(backup_dir .. old_name, backup_dir .. new_name) end end end
function OnPluginInstall () migrate_old_backups() do_backup () end
function OnPluginWorldSave () do_backup () end
